partnership_name.rationale: Partnership name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

ein.rationale: EIN is a header/identification field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year begin date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year end date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

m2_balance_beginning.rationale: Matches line 1 'Balance at beginning of year' exactly via BeginningYearBalanceAmt.

m2_capital_contributed_cash.rationale: Matches line 2a 'Capital Contributed: a Cash' exactly via CapitalContributedDurYrCashAmt.

m2_capital_contributed_property.rationale: Matches line 2b 'b Property' exactly via CapitalContributedDurYrPropAmt.

m2_net_income_loss_per_books.rationale: Matches line 3 'Net income (loss)' exactly via NetIncomeLossPerBooksAmt.

m2_other_increases.rationale: Matches line 4 'Other increases (itemize)' exactly via TotalOtherIncreasesAmt.

m2_total.rationale: Matches line 5 'Add lines 1 through 4' exactly via BalBOYCapNetIncmOtherTotalAmt.

m2_distributions_cash.rationale: Matches line 6a 'Distributions: a Cash' exactly via DistributionsCashAmt.

m2_distributions_property.rationale: Matches line 6b 'b Property' exactly via DistributionsPropertyAmt.

m2_other_decreases.rationale: Matches line 7 'Other decreases (itemize)' exactly via TotalOtherDecreasesAmt.

m2_total_decreases.rationale: Matches line 8 'Add lines 6 and 7' exactly via TotDistriAndOthDecreasesAmt.

m2_balance_end.rationale: Matches line 9 'Balance at end of year. Subtract line 8 from line 5' exactly via EndYearBalanceAmt.
